failures.question: 当前等级与最近一次会员快照等级不一致的会员有多少？按等级组合统计。
failures.generatedSql:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (member_id) member_id, level_id
  FROM member_snapshot
  ORDER BY member_id, snapshot_date DESC
)
SELECT m.level_id AS current_level_id,
       ls.level_id AS snapshot_level_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
FROM members m
JOIN latest_snapshot ls ON ls.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE m.level_id <> ls.level_id
GROUP BY m.level_id, ls.level_id
LIMIT 100;
failures.firstSql:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (member_id) member_id, level_id
  FROM member_snapshot
  ORDER BY member_id, snapshot_date DESC
)
SELECT m.level_id AS current_level_id,
       ls.level_id AS snapshot_level_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
FROM members m
JOIN latest_snapshot ls ON ls.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE m.level_id <> ls.level_id
GROUP BY m.level_id, ls.level_id
LIMIT 100;
